methods.name: list
methods.summary: Gets a list of audit logs for an account.
methods.description:
Gets a list of audit logs for an account. Can be filtered by who made the
change, on which zone, and the timeframe of the change.

props.name: id
props.description: Finds a specific log by its ID.

props.name: email
props.description: Filters by the email address of the actor that made the change.

props.name: ip
props.description:
Filters by the IP address of the request that made the change by specific IP
address or valid CIDR Range.

props.name: before
props.description:
Limits the returned results to logs older than the specified date.
A `full-date` that conforms to RFC3339.

props.name: direction
props.description: Changes the direction of the chronological sorting.

props.name: export
props.description: Indicates that this request is an export of logs in CSV format.

props.name: hide_user_logs
props.description: Indicates whether or not to hide user level audit logs.

props.name: since
props.description:
Limits the returned results to logs newer than the specified date.
A `full-date` that conforms to RFC3339.

props.name: name
props.description: Filters by the name of the zone associated to the change.
